description: This file defines the interface TaxClassDao for data access operations related to TaxClass entities, including methods to list tax classes by store and retrieve tax classes by code.

classes.name: TaxClassDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to TaxClass entities, extending generic DAO functionalities and including custom methods for retrieving tax classes by store and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxClass objects associated with the specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass object based on its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass object based on its code and associated MerchantStore.
